description.p: A cross-platform fractal viewer in the spirit of the classic Fractint. Hotkey driven, with a rubber-band zoom box, palette cycling and Fractint .map palettes.

Shallow views render instantly on the GPU; a progressive CPU renderer takes over past float32 precision, and perturbation rendering with an arbitrary-precision centre keeps zooming far beyond float64. Families include the Mandelbrot set, Burning Ship, Tricorn, Multibrot and Newton, each escape-time family with its Julia variant.

description.p: macOS app bundle in a disk image, consistent package names, saves fall back to ~/Pictures/gofract when launched from a desktop, and every snap is launch-tested before release.
Adds deb, rpm, Flatpak and Snap packages with a desktop entry and icon, a palette flag, and screenshots.
